title: Zaide’s Bulk Routine MFer
author: zaide meddeb
desc: Get absolutely swole and huge. great for bulking. definitely not cut oriented.

ex.note: set incline level to 3. (6-10 rep range)
set incline to 3. (6-10 rep range)
set seat to 6. (6-10 rep range)
1 minute rest between sets.
use enough assistance for 8-12 reps
Either incline mts chest press machine. or the iso-lateral flat bench machine. (6-10 reps)
set cable to 17. (6-12 reps)
use neutral or shorter grips to target mid to lower back.
use straight bar, shack grip or wide neutral grip to target upper to mid back. use shorter grip for lower back. pull rope up high for delts. pull rope low for lats.
CROSSBODY ISOLATED LAT PULL OVER. set cable to 7
ASSISTED wide grip pull-ups
Fly Machine or Dual Cable Machine
LUNGE MACHINE ROWS. use bottom most handles
set cable to 17
use lunge machine bottom most grip if there is no trap bar
set back to 4, set hand grip to second from bottom, set leg to -1, set ankle to large.
set back to 3, leg to 12, ankle to L. follow with weighted body squats or sissy squats
first set inwards (set machine to 7), second set outwards (set machine to 1)
set seat to 7
set bench incline to 7. bar should line up with collar bone and be about 3 fingers away from tip of your nose when seated back. keep back flat
set bench incline level to 7. squeeze at top
set seat to 4
set cable to line up 90 degrees with arm fully extended vertically. this is about hand height at cable level 17. stand upright with ever so slight learn forward. don’t let hand move up past shoulder
use rope grip on row cable machine. aim to bring the cable up into a double bi in order to activate upper back
